primaryWitnesses.text: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;
